verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI generation service that ingests user prompts and footage. Whether user data can be excluded from model training is therefore a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, an opt-out, a data retention policy, or an enterprise no-training guarantee, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
